plan.reasoning_summary: This plan operates in the pre_transaction phase, focusing on persuasion_context and new_beneficiary stages. By setting urgency_level to 5 and beneficiary_age_days to 0, we create a scenario where the system must immediately flag high-risk interactions involving unknown payees and urgent demands. The high amount_multiplier further amplifies the perceived threat level. These parameters are tightly bounded by the easy difficulty profile but push the observable signals to their most volatile extremes within that tier, ensuring the simulation tests the earliest possible defensive interventions.
